description: Checks that indentation is consistent with coding standards. Proper indentation improves code readability and maintainability. This rule ensures that all code blocks, method definitions, and class declarations follow a consistent 4-space or 2-space indentation pattern.

fix_pattern.instructions: Use consistent 4-space indentation for Java code. Recommended approach: Run google-java-format or use your IDE's auto-format feature (IntelliJ: Ctrl+Alt+L, VS Code: Shift+Alt+F).
